mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_login_log(user_id, login_ip, login_device, login_status, login_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{loginIp}, #{loginDevice}, #{loginStatus}, #{loginTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, login_ip, login_device, login_status, login_time FROM user_login_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY login_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, login_ip, login_device, login_status, login_time FROM user_login_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, login_ip, login_device, login_status, login_time FROM user_login_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND login_status = #{loginStatus} ORDER BY login_time DESC
